description: This file defines the SiloStatus enumeration to represent various lifecycle states of a silo in a distributed system, along with extension methods for checking termination states.

classes.name: SiloStatus
classes.description: Enumeration representing different statuses of a silo, such as Created, Joining, Active, ShuttingDown, Stopping, and Dead.

classes.name: SiloStatusExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for SiloStatus, specifically to determine if a silo is terminating.

methods.name: IsTerminating
methods.description: Extension method that returns true if the silo status indicates that it is shutting down, stopping, or dead.
